description: Split false merges and repair moving fibre continuations while independent signals traverse a deforming synthetic volume.
name: Branch Repair V3 · Difficulty 5 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Match each incoming fibre at the same depth in XZ. Cut the pink false bridge and stitch its matching moving outlet after the damage front opens it. Keep all gold signals in their own fibres. Escape cancels a preview; release or click inside its small ring also cancels. A completed stitch must connect two distinct matching open ports: a missed starting or ending port, wrong fusion, or escaped signal ends the attempt. A correct stitch reverses horizontal tissue drift without a position jump. Source arrows show tissue headings; outlet arrows show local flex headings. Faint scars mark future false bridges. Flow instruments show material position / units per second; targets reflect at their displayed deformation bounds. Each fully sealed lesion increases that signal's base rate by ten percent; later breaks open sooner.
